title: 433. Design Snake Game

examples.explanation: The snake eats at (1,2) on the third move and at (0,1) on the fifth move, then crashes into itself on the last move.
With no food the score stays zero while the snake loops safely.

hints: Store the body in a queue (head at front) plus a hash set of occupied cells for O(1) collision checks.
When the step does not eat, remove the tail before testing self-collision so moving into the vacated cell is legal.
Once the game ends, every remaining move reports -1.
